texte.La section U vise les ménages en tant qu: Section U covers households as employers. A private individual is not the subject of an AI governance audit. The entity that is, is the agent, the platform or the service provider that operates the systems on their behalf.

texte.La section « Implantation » compare les: The “Siting” section compares countries against SEVEN criteria, each with its nature and its source: carbon intensity, dispatchability of the mix (nuclear, renewables, fossil — # generation), water availability (the EEA’s WEI+ index, with the share of agricultural irrigation: where crops withdraw more than half of the water, evaporative cooling competes for use in summer), free-cooling potential, industrial electricity price in Eurostat classes, estate in service, and #-# connection queue counted from our statuses. Set the WEIGHT of each criterion (# to #) according to your project: the ranking is recalculated before your eyes, and the formula displayed is the formula executed — on the server side. The result is ALSO placed on the MAP of the Union, in the same projection and with the same outlines as the panel map — the geography only has to be learnt once. A Sweden / Finland / Norway podium and a Spain / Italy / Greece podium have the same ranks and do not say the same thing: one sends you north, the other south, and the map shows it at a glance. Two points to remember: the colours come from the WEIGHTS you have just set, they are not a property of the framework; and a grey country is not poorly rated, it is ABSENT from the framework — the legend says so in plain words, because on a coloured map grey is spontaneously read as a poor result. Filtering the grid does not empty the map: it keeps all of rated Europe, otherwise it would lose what justifies it, the comparison.
texte.La sensibilisation à l’embauche et le ra: Awareness training on hiring and an annual refresher are expected.
texte.La seule question de gouvernance que per: The one governance question nobody else asks: do we know what we are running? A half-recorded estate makes everything that follows from it wrong.
texte.La seule réponse sûre. Les modèles inven: The only safe answer. Models invent plausible package names, and attackers publish those invented names and wait for someone to install them — installing is enough to run their code.
texte.La stratégie de conformité réglementaire: The regulatory compliance strategy of §# and the operation and control of chapter # are found in neither ISO standard. That is exactly what the Regulation adds to an ordinary quality management system — and the reason why « we are certified # » does not answer article #.
texte.La structure harmonisée est la même : re: The harmonised structure is the same: management review, internal audit, nonconformities and documented information graft onto what you already have. You have NINE clauses left — and it is there, and nowhere else, that you find what # adds.
texte.La suite du panorama : une fois le terra: The rest of the overview: once the ground is located, this module puts figures on it — envelope, breakdown by lot, comparison between countries, value creation.
texte.La supervision humaine n’est alors pas,: Human oversight is then not, for that scenario, a risk-management measure. Two ways out, and only one is admissible: raise the category of measure — the engine says which ones remain faster —, or apply # and record in the risk-management file that real-time human intervention is technically impossible. Recording it is not an exemption: the risk remains, and other measures have to carry it.

texte.La sélection de locataires n'est listée: Tenant selection is not listed anywhere as high-risk. The absence of a classification does not mean the absence of obligations: Article # of the GDPR and the prohibition of discrimination apply in full, and they are what bites here.
texte.La sûreté vient en premier, et ce n'est: Safety comes first, and it is not a reading order: in an industrial process, a security measure that can trigger a shutdown is a safety event before it is an IT incident.
texte.La taille ne décide PAS du régime. Le ca: Size does NOT decide the regime. The simplified framework rests on five categories named in Article #(#), not on a headcount threshold: a micro-enterprise that falls into none of the five comes under the full framework.

texte.Le déployeur d'un système de reconnaissa: The deployer of an emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system informs the exposed persons about its operation and processes the data in accordance with the GDPR. Not applicable to uses permitted by law in criminal matters.
